existing_rows_audit.detail: Geneva office is confirmed real (https://www.systematica.com/contact lists Jersey, Geneva, London, New York, Singapore, Shanghai), but the firm's entire live requisition list on 2026-08-04 contains only two postings (Senior Platform Engineer - London, Platform Engineer - Geneva) per the authoritative feed https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/jobs.rss. No Quantitative Developer or Quantitative Researcher requisition is open anywhere. The row's other fields are also internally inconsistent: title 'Quantitative Developer' is tagged track 'Research', the CHF 140-210k figure has no cited source and I found no primary or credible secondary confirmation of it, and the 'new-grad/junior QR accepted' eligibility claim is not supported by any posting I could load. Treat the comp figure and eligibility text as unverified.

notes: Systematica's careers site (https://www.systematica.com/careers) 308-redirects to a Pinpoint ATS tenant at https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/. The listing block on that page is JavaScript-rendered and returns no jobs to a plain fetch, so I used the tenant's own machine-readable feed at https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/jobs.rss, which is served by the same primary host and carries full job bodies (title, department, location, hiring manager, duties, requirements). As of 2026-08-04 that feed contains exactly TWO live requisitions firm-wide: (1) 'Senior Platform Engineer', London, posted 2026-07-16, https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/jobs/548241 (resolves to https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/postings/a59e017b-731a-48f9-a365-5dcbf1fd385a); (2) 'Platform Engineer', Geneva, posted 2026-07-16, https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/jobs/548421 (resolves to https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/postings/af67febb-488c-4a65-b8ef-aa707492f573). Both are the same job text at two levels, both report to Segun Ikuesan in Technology Operations. I deliberately did NOT add either to 'roles': they are DevOps/SRE platform roles (Terraform, Ansible, HashiCorp Nomad/Consul/Vault, AWS, EKS, Grafana), the named languages are Python/Go/Bash with no C++ and no GPU/ML content, so they fall outside all four in-scope tracks. They also gate on 'at least five years' experience in platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering or a closely related role', which the candidate (~18 months by a mid-2027 start) does not meet. Neither posting states compensation; the London one lists benefits only (private medical, bonus and pension, paid parental leave). Stale roles that search engines still surface are closed: 'Data Scientist / Quantitative Analyst - London' (https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/en/jobs/66288) and 'Risk Manager - London' (https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/en/postings/9fb16dc5-6160-4426-a0c7-bedb006f7e25) both 302 back to the careers home page, meaning the requisitions were pulled. Do not trust aggregator copies of them. Offices: the firm's own contact page confirms six offices - Jersey, Geneva, London, New York, Singapore, Shanghai. In-scope of those are London, Geneva (Switzerland, non-EU but the candidate's CH permit covers it), Singapore and Shanghai. Jersey is a Crown Dependency, not the UK or EU, and would need its own work permit, so I excluded it. There is NO Tokyo office and NO Hong Kong office - do not let any row claim one. Shanghai is a mainland seat and would likely be Mandarin-first plus sponsorship; nothing is currently open there. Coverage gap: because the ATS list view is JS-only, roles that exist but are excluded from the RSS feed (e.g. confidential or internal-only requisitions) would be invisible to me; the feed and the site both agree on two openings, so I consider the count reliable but not provably exhaustive. Practical read for this candidate: Systematica is in a hiring lull for quant/research/trading seats. The right action is to file at https://systematica.pinpointhq.com/register-your-interest/new and re-check the RSS feed periodically rather than to apply now.
